sentences: Starting a new job can be intimidating, especially for introverts.
From here on out, we'll take it one day at a time, and I'll be here to support you however I can.
At PACE, we understand that sometimes, our employees might need or prefer to work from home.
We encourage a healthy balance between working in the office and remote work.
You can always adjust this as we go along, depending on your preferences and the project's needs.
As we walk, feel free to ask me any questions or let me know if there's anything at all that's on your mind.
This is a judgment-free zone, and no question is too small or insignificant.
